description.en: Local-first resume warehouse: packs work into reusable packages, imports an existing resume into a template, analyses a JD (including the school-tier preference it implies), assembles a tailored Chinese/English resume and exports a PDF named position-name-school. Adds one tool to start/stop the local app and read its health; the only outbound path is an LLM call you approve after seeing the exact field list.
description.zh: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的 Package、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。插件提供一个工具用于启动/停止本机应用并读取健康状态；除你确认过字段清单的 LLM 调用外，数据不出本机。
